interpretation: The in-circuit 15-kohm reading supports the 18C/15-kohm interpretation for R44. Stability and probe baseline were not reported. This does not prove isolated value, tolerance or Q1 pin roles. It leaves B61 TP14-to-Q1.R = 516 ohm unexplained by the settled insulated-gate model. Preserve both reports; do not merge nets or declare a failed device.
